scope: Isolated temporary SQLite operation-store persistence across two owned child Python processes. Metadata fixtures only; no weather recipe was computed.

command_bindings.child_source:
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from nowcast.operation_store import OperationsStore

store = OperationsStore(Path(sys.argv[1]))
phase = sys.argv[2]
identity = {"recipe": "isolated-restart-proof-v1", "scope": "metadata_fixture_only"}
completed = store.enqueue("starter_audit", {**identity, "case": "completed"}, {}, "metadata_fixture_only")
if phase == "create":
    claimed = store.claim()
    assert claimed["id"] == completed["id"]
    assert store.finish(claimed["id"], claimed["attempt_token"], {
        "summary": {"proof": "durable_metadata_only", "scientific_recipe_executed": False}, "artifacts": []})
queued = store.enqueue("radar_replay", {**identity, "case": "queued"}, {}, "metadata_fixture_only")
records = {}
for label, identifier in (("completed", completed["id"]), ("queued", queued["id"])):
    row = store.get(identifier)
    fields = ("id", "kind", "status", "attempt", "created_at", "updated_at", "started_at", "finished_at", "summary", "artifacts")
    records[label] = {key: row[key] for key in fields}
    records[label]["full_record_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
assert len(store.jobs()) == 2
print(json.dumps({"pid": os.getpid(), "phase": phase, "records": records}, sort_keys=True))

limitations: This does not restart or exercise the lifetime of the currently running HTTP service or research worker.
It does not execute training, radar prediction or source auditing; job kinds are metadata fixtures here.
Actual worker-lock contention and crash release are covered separately by tests.test_operations_runtime.
